create_localcheckpoint: create a LocalCheckpoint instance with a file path to manage PyTorch model checkpoint saving and loading
save_checkpoint_with_retry: save model parameters to a checkpoint file with automatic retry on failure up to 10 attempts
initialize_from_checkpoint: initialize model parameters by loading an existing checkpoint file or using fresh parameters if none exists
upgrade_state_dict: upgrade an old checkpoint state dictionary to add missing model config fields for backward compatibility
review_localcheckpoint_class: review the LocalCheckpoint class and its initialize and save methods for checkpoint management patterns
